reason: A DeepSeek Harness utility that improves model-request resilience on unreliable networks through retries, local response caching, heartbeat reconnection, degraded-mode controls, and status/configuration UI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供弱网适配，通过请求重试、本地响应缓存、心跳重连和降级控制提升模型回复链路的连续性。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness utility that helps maintain model reply continuity on unreliable networks with request retries, local response caching, heartbeat reconnection, and degraded-mode controls.

capabilities: Intercepts and retries model streaming requests on configured network-related failures
Caches successful model responses locally for replay
Performs configurable heartbeat HTTP probes to detect connectivity
Provides a bilingual settings page and network status display
Optionally reduces output limits and prunes tool results during degraded operation
Persists configuration to a workspace-local JSON file
